intro.title: Arcads AI Video — Agent Skill Pack
intro.desc: Create AI marketing videos and images using your Arcads account, powered by AI agents in Claude Code or Cursor. Supports the full Arcads creative stack — Seedance 2.0 (flagship video), Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Grok Video, Nano Banana 2 / Pro / Edit, ChatGPT Image 2, OmniHuman, and Audio-driven — plus a 37-template static Meta image-ad library and a pipeline for Pixar-style and claymation animated ads.
